Thank you for calling the Copper Kitchen. We are open from twelve to eleven every day. Our kitchen serves appetizers until ten, and the last main course goes out at ten thirty. On Tuesdays every main course comes with a free side dish. We do not add a tip to the check, so please leave what you think is fair. If you would like food to go, press two and we will take your order now.

Good evening and welcome. Let me tell you about tonight before you order. The appetizer of the day is tomato soup, and the main course is grilled salmon with two side dishes. The steak comes medium rare unless you ask for something else. Water and coffee come with a free refill. If you finish and there is still food on the plate, we can pack it to go. I will be back in five minutes to take your order.

First, the server shows Thiago to the table and brings the menu. Then he orders some sparkling water and an appetizer. After that, he asks for the steak and says how he would like it cooked. Next, he chooses a side dish and asks for a refill of water. Finally, he asks for the check and leaves a tip.
